definitions.gloss: cash payment; spot cash; immediate payment
definitions.explanation: Payment made in full and in cash at the time of purchase, without installments, credit, or deferred payment.

examples.japanese: {即金|そっきん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: To buy with cash on the spot.

examples.japanese: {即金|そっきん}{払|ばら}いなら⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: If you pay in cash, I'll give you a small discount.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中古車|ちゅうこしゃ}→中古車：25939_chuukosha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{即金|そっきん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦ローン→ローン：06579_roon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I bought the used car with cash up front, so I don't have to worry about loan payments.

notes:
Composed of {即|そく} (immediate) + {金|きん} (money, cash). Emphasizes that payment is made on the spot without any delayed or installment payment arrangement. Often used in buying and selling contexts, particularly for larger purchases.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {即金|そっきん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy with cash on the spot
- {即金|そっきん}{払|ばら}い: cash payment, paying in full
- {即金|そっきん}⟦{買取|かいとり}→買取：14366_kaitori⟧: cash purchase (of goods for resale)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧: cash — the general term for physical money; does not imply immediacy
- ⟦{一括払|いっかつばら}い→一括払い：17608_ikkatsubarai⟧: lump-sum payment — paying the full amount at once, but not necessarily in cash
- ⟦{分割払|ぶんかつばら}い→分割払い：17607_bunkatsubarai⟧: installment payment — the opposite; paying in multiple smaller amounts over time
